topics.title: Payload HMAC-SHA256 Signing & Verification
topics.objective: Sign outbound webhook payloads using secret HMAC keys to verify authenticity and integrity.
topics.exercise: Implement payload signing and a middleware verification function rejecting tampered requests.

topics.title: Exponential Backoff & Jittered Delivery Queues
topics.objective: Retry failed delivery attempts using exponential backoff with decorrelated jitter to avoid stampedes.
topics.exercise: Implement a retry worker schedule retrying up to 5 times over 24 hours with jitter.

topics.title: Idempotency Keys & Deduplication Caches
topics.objective: Prevent duplicate payment or transaction processing on repeated webhook deliveries.
topics.exercise: Write an idempotent consumer checking an Redis lock before processing order events.

topics.title: Dead-Letter Queues (DLQ) & Failure Inspection
topics.objective: Capture permanently unroutable events for developer debugging and manual replay.
topics.example: dlq.publish({ endpoint, payload, attempts: 5, last_error: '504 Gateway Timeout' })
topics.exercise: Build an administrative dashboard endpoint to replay messages from a dead letter queue.

topics.title: Per-Endpoint Rate Limiting & Circuit Breaking
topics.objective: Throttle outbound dispatch rates so that third-party customer servers are not overwhelmed.
topics.exercise: Construct a token bucket rate limiter restricting deliveries to a maximum of 50 requests/sec per customer URL.
